title: Entralink room
description: One room of the Entralink roguelike (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md, The room format): the rounds it is kept to, its role, its weather, its battles and the NPCs standing in it. Its ID is the file's name. Edited in the editor's Entree page; it replaces challenges/ once the game reads it (the wiring step), until then the game reads challenges/.

name.description: The room's name, for the editor

rounds.description: The rounds of a run it is kept to, each once: 1 before the first boss, 2 before the second, 3 before the final room. Left out, it can come up in any round

role.description: room: a room of a round. boss: the room ending round 1 or 2, from the bosses' own pool. final: the run's last room

weather.description: The weather of its battles from their start (constants/battle.h; BTL_WEATHER_NONE for clear); random if left out

battles.description: Its battles, each started by the battle NPCs that name it

npcs.description: What stands in the room. If none spawns, the room is free and the player goes on

id.description: Its name in the room, which battle NPCs name it by

format.description: single: one enemy. double: one or two. triple: one to three. raid: exactly one, in the center of a triple battle against three of the player's Pokémon

level.description: Its base level, 70 if left out; the run will scale it with the rooms visited

moves.description: Its moves, in order, replacing the ones it has by its level

ability.description: An ABILITY_* it has whatever its species', or "hidden" for its hidden one; without it, one of its species' two

item.description: Its held item; none if left out

gender.description: As its species allows; random if left out

type.description: battle: starts the battle it names. item: gives an item. rest: opens the rest menu. buff: opens the buff menu (both built later)

battle.description: A battle NPC's battle, by its id; several NPCs may start the same one

enemy.description: A battle NPC: the enemy of its battle (0 the first) whose overworld sprite it shows and whose cry it plays; 0 if left out

count.description: How many of its item it gives; 1 if left out

sprite.description: Its overworld sprite. Without it a battle NPC shows its enemy's walking Pokémon and an item NPC the item ball (OBJ_CODE_110); rest and buff NPCs need one

flag.description: It spawns only while this flag is set; always if left out

chance.description: Its chance to spawn, in percent; 100 if left out

x.description: Its tile, 0-31 from the room's left; every forest clearing has the same 32 by 32 grid and exits

z.description: Its tile, 0-31 from the room's top
